dataType.description: The Type that should be invoked to retrieve data for the {@link PdfComponent}.

actionName.description: The default action is fetch for the event data spec.

actionArgs.description:
The arguments supplied to {@link PdfComponentDataSpec#actionName}. No arguments supplied
if not specified.

legendLabel.description: The label of the events in the legend of the chart.

markerSize.description: The size of the marker displayed.

timeField.description:
The field on the `dataType` which will be used to display the events on the timeseries chart
and is filtered within the range of {@link PdfTimeseriesChartDataSpec#start} and {@link PdfTimeseriesChartDataSpec#end}.
